## `GET /tuning-sessions`

Lists tuning sessions.

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                               |
| ------ | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `200`  | Successful Response | array of [SessionResource](/reference/api/models/#sessionresource) |

## `POST /tuning-sessions`

Start a session. One at a time (409 while another is active): they share the GPU.

**Request body:** [SessionCreate](/reference/api/models/#sessioncreate) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                      |
| ------ | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `201`  | Successful Response | [SessionResource](/reference/api/models/#sessionresource) |

## `GET /tuning-sessions/{session_id}`

Returns one tuning session.

| Parameter    | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ------------ | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `session_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [SessionResource](/reference/api/models/#sessionresource)         |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `POST /tuning-sessions/{session_id}/approve`

Manual mode: run the step the session proposed.

| Parameter    | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ------------ | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `session_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [SessionResource](/reference/api/models/#sessionresource)         |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `POST /tuning-sessions/{session_id}/cancel`

Stop issuing steps and free the GPU; a run already started finishes on its own.

| Parameter    | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ------------ | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `session_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [SessionResource](/reference/api/models/#sessionresource)         |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |
